label: Story and hypothetical scenario openings
explanation: The feature fires in multi-token bursts on clauses that launch a narrative or hypothetical scenario — fairy-tale openings ("Once upon a time," "One day, two friends headed..."), story introductions ("Here is the story:"), and imaginative framings ("Suppose you have...," "Imagine that...," "If you train...," "you begin to dream..."). It fires most strongly on canonical story openings, often right after a title, section break, or <|endoftext|>, and stops once the scenario is established; the fired-on tokens themselves are just common words with near-zero conditional rates, so discourse context, not token identity, drives it. Weak firings are scattered noise on frequent tokens with no clear pattern.
